Dear Sir(s) / Madam, 
 
Sub.: Scheme of Amalgamation – Update  
  
Ref.: Our intimation dated August 5, 2026 and September 25, 2026 
  
We refer to our letters dated August 5, 2026 and September 25, 2026, providing an 
update about the sanctioning of the Scheme of Amalgamation of the ten wholly owned 
subsidiaries namely (i) Adani Power Dahej Limited; (ii) Kutchh Power Generation Limited 
(a step down wholly owned subsidiary of APL); (iii) Resurgent Fuel Management 
Limited; (iv) Mahan Fuel Management Limited; (v) Orissa Thermal Energy Limited; (vi) 
Korba Power Limited; (vii) Anuppur Thermal Energy (MP) Private Limited; (viii) Mirzapur 
Thermal Energy (UP) Private Limited and (ix) Emberiza Infra Park Limited and (x) 
Vidarbha Industries Power Limited, with APL (the “Scheme”), by the Hon’ble National 
Company Law Tribunal, Bench at Ahmedabad, vide its order dated August 4, 2026 and 
Hon’ble National Company Law Tribunal, Bench at Mumbai, vide its order dated 
September 24, 2026. 
 
Further to our aforesaid letters, we wish to inform and update you that all the 
conditions to make the Scheme effective, as specified under the Scheme, have been 
fulfilled. Accordingly, the Scheme has become effective today, i.e., September 25, 2026 
(“Effective Date”) and consequently, the above mentioned ten wholly owned 
subsidiaries stand amalgamated with Adani Power Limited and dissolved without being 
wound up. In accordance with the Scheme, the Appointed Date of the Scheme is April 
1, 2025. 
 
Kindly take the above on record. 
 
Thanking you.  
 
Yours faithfully,  
For Adani Power Limited 
 
 
 
Puneet Bansal 
Company Secretary
